reference.pathophysiology: ISSVA flow labelling splits high-flow nidus shunts from low-flow venous and lymphatic lesions; AVM work must penetrate the nidus since proximal ties recruit collaterals, low-flow lesions shrink with sclerosants, and infantile haemangioma is a propranolol tumour rather than a needle case.
additionalDifferentials: AVM versus fistula by nidus presence
Venous versus lymphatic by cysts and stones
Haemangioma versus malformation by growth course
additionalInvestigations: Duplex for flow direction and shunt
